title: Level 2 (Intermediate) - A-7
notes:
South must lose tricks to the ♦A and the ♣A. West's heart lead has created 2 heart losers.

South must try to dispose of his 2 heart losers immediately. If South leads either diamonds or clubs first, West will win and cash the setting tricks in hearts.

South can discard 1 of his heart losers on dummy's top spades. However, one discard is not enough. South must risk the spade finesse. South leads low to dummy's ♠J at trick 2, playing West for the ♠Q. When that finesse works, South can get rid of both of his heart losers on North's ♠A and ♠K. South thus makes his contract losing tricks to only the ♦A and ♣A.
